elements.element: Customer has no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 expressly prohibits the Company from participating in similar Internet projects involving Deerskin Products and grants HDI an exclusive Deerskin brand right.

elements.element: Exclusivity is limited to a defined product category.
elements.evidence: Section 6.1 limits the restriction to the identified category of “Deerskin Products” and removes the broader restriction covering substantially similar products.

elements.element: Exclusivity lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: The Exclusivity Period is expressly limited to twelve months commencing on the Effective Date.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet service levels.
elements.evidence: Termination for other performance failures applies only to material failures that remain uncured for 30 days after written notice; it does not provide automatic termination upon any failure to meet service levels.

elements.element: Exclusivity ends automatically if Vendor fails to meet delivery dates.
elements.evidence: The clause automatically terminates exclusivity for failure to make the Site operational within the Section 1.6 period, but does not cover Vendor failures to meet delivery dates generally; other failures must be material and remain uncured after notice.
